    Description
    PerkBoostEndEvent
    Called after a player's temporary boost ended: removed early, such as with /zx perks clear, or run out.

    Why the boost ended.
    PerkBoostGrantEvent
    Called after a player was given a temporary boost and it was stored.
    PerkLimitReachedEvent
    Called when a perk limit stops a player: hosting one more custom game than their tier allows, making a private game, inviting someone to a full party, using the team changer.
    ServerBoostEndEvent
    Called when a server-wide boost stops applying on this server, as its end is announced to the players here.
    ServerBoostEndEvent.Reason
    Why the boost ended.
    ServerBoostStartEvent
    Called when a server-wide boost starts applying on this server, as it is announced to the players here: on the server that started it at once, and on the others sharing its database as they read it, within half a minute.
    TimedTierEndEvent
    Called after a tier a player was given for a time ended: taken back early, such as with /zx perks revoke, or run out.
    TimedTierEndEvent.Reason
    Why the grant ended.
    TimedTierGrantEvent
    Called after a player was given a tier for a time, such as with /zx perks grant, and the grant was stored.
